findings.location: Theorem 9 (6.5), PDF p.40 / printed p.260; bootstrap (6.9)-(6.10) p.41; final proof step p.46; dependencies pp.64-66
findings.claim: Differentiated balanced product bounded by d_lambda*d_mu*lambda^(-1/2).
findings.complete_check: u=0 solves cubic QNLS g=1+|u|^2,N=|u|^2u; T=1 << epsilon^-4; choose normalized compact-Fourier Schwartz phi in narrow annulus, v_lambda=lambda^(1/2)e^{i lambda^2 t partial_y^2}phi(lambda x), f=0,d=1,mu=lambda,x0=0. All hypotheses hold. On [0,lambda^-2], norm equals A lambda^(1/2), A>0 by Schwartz decay and continuity. Printed bound implies A lambda<=K for all dyadic lambda, impossible.
findings.counterevidence: Theorem 8 and (3.2),(3.6) use positive half-power; (6.12),(6.14),(6.17) yield positive half-power. Likely transcription origin; no counterexample to main existence conclusions.
findings.impact: Invalid quantitative core input and claimed derivation/continuation used in Section 8. Major calibration restricted to this guarantee, not whole-paper refutation.
findings.repair_limit: Positive half-power and consistent bootstrap are necessary and match scaling; complete variable-coefficient repair through all later estimates not certified.

claim_checks.source: Theorem 9 (6.5), PDF p. 40; bootstrap p. 41; proof pp. 43-46; uses pp. 64-66
claim_checks.independent_reason: The zero background solves the allowed cubic QNLS model g=1+|u|^2, N=|u|^2u. Set T=1, f=0, mu=lambda, x0=0 and normalize a Schwartz free solution with compact Fourier support in the permitted narrow dyadic annulus. With v_lambda(t,x)=lambda^(1/2) w(lambda^2 t,lambda x), the derivative of |v_lambda|^2 contributes lambda^2 and dt dx contributes lambda^(-3); its L2 norm over [0,lambda^(-2)] is A lambda^(1/2), A>0. The printed negative half-power would force A lambda to be uniformly bounded. All small-background and time assumptions are satisfied.
claim_checks.counterevidence_and_impact: The positive half-power in Theorem 8 and earlier formulas, together with the squared Morawetz bound of order lambda on pp. 43-44, supports a transcription/inference error. The printed negative half-power and its use in the continuation argument are invalid core quantitative steps, supporting Major under the operative criterion. The main existence conclusions are not disproved.
claim_checks.correction_scope: Retain the report's limit: changing the exponent and bootstrap is necessary, but a complete variable-coefficient repair through all downstream estimates has not been independently certified.
